reported_success.quote: Overall, the results of the present study are largely consistent with Barrett et al. (2010), conceptually replicating the ﬁndings

notes: Known test mismatch: replication estimates condition × SNS on arousal; original estimates arousal × SNS on nostalgia. BANPS model selected to parallel original ANPS model. Replication prose p < .01; exact adjusted p .003 selected from Table 11. Alternative TIPI model prints β = 0.35, t(1678) = 3.37, adjusted p = .01 (Table 11). Success is an overall author verdict, not an explicit verdict for this particular interaction. Original analytic n left null because the study-level total is not explicitly established for the selected test; no n derived from degrees of freedom.
